subject: Renewal / expansion: volume step-ups & blended rates — follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Subject: Recap + next steps from today — usage, budget, target $/1M tokens

Hi Sanjay / Lisa —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and can get you a renewal/expansion proposal that matches your cost targets.

Summary of what I heard:
- Current usage: ~30M tokens/month across customer-facing chat and search routes.
- Expected ramp: 30M -> 100M over the next 6 months, and potentially 200M by month 12 if the pilot succeeds.
- Primary models/routes: chat (text-gen, llm-large), search/rerank (embed + rerank model), some low-latency assistant calls.
- Budget range for next 12 months: $30k–$50k/month initially; procurement wants to see unit economics / $ per 1M tokens to evaluate scale.

To move to a firm renewal + expansion contract we need two things from you:
1) Confirm expected monthly token profile (month-by-month or buckets: 0–50M, 50–200M, 200M+).
2) Target $/1M tokens (or target monthly spend) you’re comfortable with for the 12 month commit. You mentioned aiming for ~ $700/1M tokens as a target on the call — is that still reasonable?

Attached is a simple usage estimate workbook (MAD-usage-estimate.xlsx) and a sample blended-rate model for reference.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the token buckets by EOD Wed (6/17).
- I’ll run a blended-rate proposal and step-up schedule and loop Rishi (SE) to advise on model routing and cost optimizations (quantization / caching).
- If it looks good, we’ll send a term sheet and a DocuSign for the renewal + expansion.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today — usage, budget, target $/1M tokens

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the sheet — useful. A few clarifications from our side so you can size the quote:

1) Token profile (rough buckets):
- Months 1–3 (pilot): 25–35M tokens/month (mostly chat).
- Months 4–9 (scale): 80–120M tokens/month (chat + search increases).
- Months 10–12 (full rollout): 180–220M tokens/month (new routes and higher concurrency).

2) Budget / target pricing:
- Procurement is targeting an average blended rate around $650–$750 per 1M tokens across the contract. They expect blended because routing will mix higher- and lower-cost models.
- If you can show a step-up schedule that gets us into ~$700/1M on average at scale (100–200M), procurement will be happy to move quickly.

3) Other notes:
- We care about predictable billing cadence and a cap on token overage charges until we reach the next threshold.
- We want to be able to add a new route in Q4 (multi-turn assistant) and have that included under the same blended tiers if possible.

Can you send a proposed step-up / blended-rate table and an example invoice calculation for the first 6 months?

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of AI Platforms, Stellar Retail
sanjay@stellarretail.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellarretail.com>, Lisa Kim <lisa.kim@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed step-ups & blended-rate examples (incl. invoice calc)

Hi Sanjay / Lisa —

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. I ran a few blended scenarios with Rishi and Neha and attached a one-pager (redwood-pricing-tearsheet.pdf) plus a worked invoice example for months 1–6 (bottom of the workbook). High level: we can structure volume step-ups and blended rates to hit your ~$700/1M target at scale while still giving protection early in the ramp.

Proposed structure (example):
- Tier A: 0–50M tokens/month — list rate $1,200 per 1M tokens
- Tier B: 50–200M tokens/month — list rate $850 per 1M tokens
- Tier C: 200M+ tokens/month — list rate $600 per 1M tokens

Blended example (month where usage = 100M):
- 50M @ $1,200 = $60,000
- 50M @ $850 = $42,500
- Total = $102,500 => blended = $1,025 per 1M tokens

We know list rates are higher than your target; here are two ways to reach your $650–$750/1M objective:
1) Committed discount (preferred): commit to a ramped annual volume (e.g., 1.5B tokens/year) and we apply a contracted discount ladder that yields a blended effective rate near $700/1M at 100–200M/month. We can model a blended effective rate of $700 by applying a 35–45% discount across tiers depending on year commitment.
2) Blended guaranteed rate + step-ups: instead of strict tier accounting, we can offer a guaranteed blended target rate for the quarter (e.g., $720/1M) with a reconciliation at quarter end. This gives you budgeting predictability and lets you add routes without surprise step-ups mid-quarter.

Additional considerations we baked in:
- Add-new-route clause: for new routes (like multi-turn assistant in Q4), we can include up to X tokens/month in the tier without moving the customer into the next step until a 30-day observation window.
- Overage cap: until you reach the next threshold, overage is invoiced at the next-tier list rate capped at a delta of 20% until waiver or tier reconciliation.
- Model routing: Rishi recommends routing non-customer-facing batch work to lower-cost model variants and reserving higher-cost models for sensitive latency/quality paths. This materially reduces blended spend; see attached TEARSHEET for an example routing config.

Example invoice calc (months 1–6 ramp modeled in attached workbook) is included. If this structure looks reasonable we’ll:
- Turn this into a formal proposal with committed volumes and exact discount ladder.
- Draft a term sheet with add-route language and the reconciliation approach.
- Issue DocuSign once procurement confirms signatory.

Questions for you:
- Does procurement require a hard per-token cap or is a blended budget target acceptable?
- Any internal approval deadlines we should align to (procurement / legal)?

I’ve cc’d Rishi to weigh in on routing optimizations and Neha for renewal terms and legal hooks.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
